slots.job: Bridge the copy-led proposition into the accountability chain as a quiet horizontal seam without turning Company into a hero-image route or a headcount story.
evaluation: supporting rather than dominating the opening
slots.selectionReason: The authored seam renders at its intrinsic 5:2 ratio in a carrier capped at 640x256 on 1440 and 1024 viewports, resolving to 350x140 at 390, aligned to the content-grid end. It sits between the proposition and chain without crossing a row. The v2 pair is review-only and is not an automatic fallback; a visible failure stops route acceptance and returns the route decision to Codex.
